description: This file defines two data pipe classes, ConcaterMapDataPipe and ZipperMapDataPipe, for combining multiple MapDataPipes via concatenation and zipping, respectively. It includes class definitions, methods for data access, and usage examples.

classes.name: ConcaterMapDataPipe
classes.description: A data pipe class that concatenates multiple MapDataPipes into a single data stream.

classes.name: ZipperMapDataPipe
classes.description: A data pipe class that zips multiple MapDataPipes into tuples, stopping at the shortest input.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the data pipe with given MapDataPipes, checking for validity.

methods.name: __getitem__
methods.description: Retrieves an item at a specific index, handling concatenation or zipping logic.

methods.name: __len__
methods.description: Returns the total length of the concatenated or zipped data pipe.
